answer: I gate each new miner with a bonded hardware handshake. The agent locks 2,000 tokens and submits a signed TPM quote tied to one physical machine, plus the copper serial etched on the board at manufacture. The bond releases over a 30 day spiral, so farming identities stays slow and any duplicate fingerprint gets slashed 50 percent. Running 100 sybils costs 200,000 tokens, about $18,000, plus 100 TPM modules at $40 each, and a month of waiting before the fable of cheap identity pays out anything at all, with each extra rack slot adding 6 hours of manual copper-serial audit.
